// B15 — Build Operator-design-system HTML for the Forecast email const d = $input.item.json; const sevColor = { high: '#f43f5e', med: '#f59e0b', low: '#10b981' }; const riskRowsHtml = (d.riskRows || []).map(r => ` ${r.debtor} ${r.invoice || '—'} ${r.amount} ${r.days}d ${r.stage || '—'} `).join('') || 'No overdue invoices 🎉'; const concentrationCard = d.concentration ? `

⚠ CONCENTRATION RISK

${d.concentration.name} represents ${d.concentration.pct}% of your 14-day expected receipts (R${Math.round(d.concentration.amt).toLocaleString('en-ZA')}). One missed payment = a rough week.

` : ''; const html = `

NSM · B15 CASH FLOW

Cash Flow Forecast

${d.todayDisplay}

NEXT 7 DAYS

${d.total7Fmt}

Inv ${d.exp7Fmt} + Rec ${d.rec7Fmt}

NEXT 14 DAYS

${d.total14Fmt}

Inv ${d.exp14Fmt} + Rec ${d.rec14Fmt}

NEXT 30 DAYS

${d.total30Fmt}

Inv ${d.exp30Fmt} + Rec ${d.rec30Fmt}
${concentrationCard}

⚡ RECOMMENDED ACTION

${d.topActionText}

OVERDUE INVOICES (${d.overdueAnyCount}, ${d.totalOverdueFmt} total)

${riskRowsHtml}
DEBTOR INVOICE AMOUNT OVERDUE STAGE

NSM · BUILT IN JOBURG · LAST UPDATED ${d.runAtSAST}

`; return { ...d, subject: '💰 Cash Flow — ' + d.total7Fmt + ' next 7d · ' + d.total14Fmt + ' next 14d', html };

parameters.subject: =💤 Cash Flow — quiet week ahead
